en-us.Riverside_Fireworks_Begin_EV01: The embankment is packed. With a shrill whistle the first firework streaks into the night sky - the fireworks festival has begun!
en-us.Riverside_Fireworks_Begin_join: $joining.name$ found a spot on the riverbank with a clear view of the sky. Another burst of fireworks spread overhead, drawing cheers from the crowd.
en-us.Riverside_Fireworks_Begin_late: By the time $joining.name$ reached the riverbank, the display was well under way. In the lull before the next volley, a viewing spot finally opened up.
en-us.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_EV01: $waited.name$ set off slowly along the riverside promenade.
en-us.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_late: $late.name$ arrived a little late, but still managed to join the riverside stroll.
en-us.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_join: $joining.name$ stepped onto the promenade and caught up with the walkers.
en-us.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_shared_initial: $attendees.name$ walked side by side along the river, chatting about little things along the way. By the bend, nobody had to make an effort to match anyone else's pace.
en-us.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_shared_arrival: $companions.name$ slowed down to walk the next stretch of riverbank with $joining.name$. The conversation picked up again, and their footsteps gradually fell into step.
en-us.Riverside_Stroll_Begin_finish: A breeze brushed the promenade as the walk continued.
